title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 14: the great drought, empty cisterns, prophets who prophesy lies, and the plea that only Yahweh can give rain.

questions.text: Concerning what did this word of Yahweh come to Jeremiah?
questions.explanation: The chapter opens: "This is Yahweh's word that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought."

answers.text: The drought
The siege of Jerusalem
The king of Babylon
The locust plague

questions.text: What do the little ones sent by the nobles find at the cisterns?
questions.explanation: The nobles send their little ones to the waters; they come to the cisterns, find no water, and return with their vessels empty.

answers.text: Bitter water
Enemy soldiers
No water
Broken vessels

questions.text: Why does the doe in the field forsake her young?
questions.explanation: The doe in the field calves and forsakes her young, because there is no grass.

answers.text: Because the hunters pursue her
Because there is no grass
Because the rivers have flooded
Because jackals surround her

questions.text: By what title is Yahweh addressed in the prayer of this chapter?
questions.explanation: The prayer addresses Him: "You hope of Israel, its Savior in the time of trouble," asking why He should be as a foreigner in the land.

answers.text: Shepherd of Jacob in the day of trouble
Rock of Israel, its strength in the storm
Father of Israel, its King from of old
Hope of Israel, its Savior in the time of trouble

questions.text: What does Yahweh tell Jeremiah not to do for this people?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said to Jeremiah, "Don't pray for this people for their good."

answers.text: Weep for them
Pray for their good
Offer sacrifices for them
Teach them the law

questions.text: By which three things does Yahweh say He will consume the people when He does not hear their fasting?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says that when they fast He will not hear their cry, but He will consume them by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence.

answers.text: By the sword, by famine, and by pestilence
By fire, by hail, and by darkness
By drought, by locusts, and by exile
By serpents, by storms, and by plague

questions.text: What do the prophets tell the people, according to Jeremiah's complaint?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah says the prophets tell them, "You will not see the sword, neither will you have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place."

answers.text: That the exile will last seventy years
That they must flee to the mountains
That Yahweh will send rain if they repent
That they will have assured peace, without sword or famine

questions.text: What does Yahweh say about the prophets who prophesy in His name?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "The prophets prophesy lies in my name. I didn't send them. I didn't command them. I didn't speak to them."

answers.text: They have misread His words
They speak only half the truth
They prophesy lies; He did not send them
They will lead the people back to Him

questions.text: With what is the virgin daughter of my people broken, in the word Jeremiah must speak?
questions.explanation: He must say, "Let my eyes run down with tears night and day... for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous wound."

answers.text: With chains of iron and bronze
With a great breach, a very grievous wound
With a burning fever in the night
With hunger and thirst in the streets

questions.text: What does the closing prayer ask about the vanities of the nations?
questions.explanation: The prayer asks, "Are there any among the vanities of the nations that can cause rain?" and confesses that Yahweh has made all these things.

answers.text: Whether any of them can cause rain
Whether any of them can raise the dead
Whether any of them can see the heart
Whether any of them can stop the sword
